statistics.standardDeviation: Population standard deviation across seeds (divide by N).
statistics.quantiles: Linear interpolation between adjacent sorted observations.
statistics.worstCase: Maximum observed value in the seed group.
statistics.clearanceTime: Per-run mean duration across that run’s blocking episodes; baseline window is 420 m and CLEARPATH window is the predicted corridor length.
statistics.improvement: Per-seed paired percentage: 100 * (baseline - CLEARPATH) / baseline; aggregate values summarize those paired percentages.
